title: ReasoningShield: SAFETY DETECTION OVER REASONING TRACES OF LARGE REASONING MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the moderation model's ability to classify and detect hate speech, discrimination, and stereotyping against specific demographic groups within the reasoning traces (Chain-of-Thoughts) of Large Reasoning Models using human-annotated safety benchmarks (e.g., AIR-Bench, SALAD-Bench, BeaverTails).
Testing the model's capacity to identify disrespectful portrayals of cultures or customs within intermediate reasoning steps as part of a 10-category safety risk taxonomy.
